name: Agastache Rugosa
original_name: アガスターシェルゴサ
source:
The same black hair as the witch who cursed this country. The same abhorred power.

That power, which can even spawn monsters, might be the only hope to break the curse binding the land.

On the night her best friend is consumed by the curse, she meets a young man.

The hands she chooses to take will change closed fates and the meaning of her accursed power.

A modern-era battle fantasy otome game where different truths are revealed based on your choices.
translation:
与当年诅咒了这个国家的魔女如出一辙的黑发，以及同样受世人厌弃的异能。

那股甚至能够孕育出魔物的力量，或许正是斩断束缚这片大地诅咒的唯一希望。

在挚友被诅咒吞噬的那个夜晚，她邂逅了一名青年。

她最终选择握住哪一双手，将改写原本闭锁的宿命，也将重塑这身受诅咒之力的真正意义。

一部现代奇幻战斗乙女游戏——根据你的选择不同，截然不同的真相将逐一揭晓。
